conclusion: The OAuth prepaid family is gated on the organization's subscription plan (Pro/Max/Ultra), resolved from the token, not the path org; it reads the subscription org's Claude Code prepaid wallet (empty), never the Console API wallet. Console billing routes reject every OAuth token. With all three OAuth identities tried (Max, Claude Code Console, ant CLI Console), no OAuth route reads purchased or promotional API credit. Public Admin API cost/usage reports are pre-credit spend (and need org:admin), not a balance.
